record_scope_reconstruction: Single named Simón Bolívar bridge phase. The national election order does not expand this operational observation to all Venezuela–Colombia posts.

source_checks.finding: May 27 report explicitly names Simón Bolívar and both traffic lanes, closed May 23–26 and circulating after 06:00 May 27.

sites.name: Simón Bolívar international road bridge
sites.coordinate_method: Bounding-box centre of named OSM feature geometry
sites.precision: Approximate crossing/structure reference; not a survey of the historical gate or protest barrier.
sites.evidence_note: Named OSM bridge across Táchira River between San Antonio del Táchira and La Parada; no substitution of the Francisco de Paula Santander or Atanasio Girardot bridges.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Ordinary pedestrian and vehicle passage at San Antonio’s principal customs access to the Simón Bolívar bridge on the Venezuela–Colombia frontier during the May 2025 election restriction.

date_scope_check.assessment: Dates, movement exceptions, endpoint qualification and >24-hour status remain as recorded; geographic reference does not independently establish uninterrupted closure or extend last-confirmed observations.
